description: Org-wide inherited config for linked-fw. Mend applies this to every installed repository automatically, with no per-repo file. The policy itself lives in default.json in this repo -- this file only carries the two switches a preset is not permitted to set. Note: Mend only picks this file up when it detects a COMMIT to it, and only if the app was already installed on this repo at the time, so if it is not taking effect, push a commit here and wait a minute.
